def attach_particle(word: str, particle: str) -> str:
    if not word:
        return word
    
    last_char = word[-1]
    
    # Sino-Korean number pronunciation and whether they have batchim
    # True = has batchim, False = no batchim
    digit_batchim = {
        '0': False,  # 영
        '1': True,   # 일 (ㄹ)
        '2': False,  # 이
        '3': True,   # 삼 (ㅁ)
        '4': False,  # 사
        '5': False,  # 오
        '6': True,   # 육 (ㄱ)
        '7': True,   # 칠 (ㄹ)
        '8': True,   # 팔 (ㄹ)
        '9': False,  # 구
    }
    
    # Check if last character is a digit
    if last_char.isdigit():
        has_batchim = digit_batchim[last_char]
    else:
        # Check if it's a Hangul syllable
        code = ord(last_char)
        if 0xAC00 <= code <= 0xD7A3:  # Hangul syllable range
            # Decompose to get jongseong (final consonant)
            jongseong_index = (code - 0xAC00) % 28
            has_batchim = jongseong_index > 0
            
            # Special case for "으로/로": if jongseong is ㄹ, treat as no batchim
            if particle == "으로/로" and jongseong_index == 8:  # 8 is ㄹ
                has_batchim = False
        else:
            # Not a Hangul syllable or digit, assume no batchim
            has_batchim = False
    
    # Select the appropriate particle form
    forms = particle.split('/')
    if has_batchim:
        selected_particle = forms[0]  # Before slash (with batchim)
    else:
        selected_particle = forms[1]  # After slash (without batchim)
    
    return word + selected_particle

    # Sino-Korean pronunciation and batchim status

    single_digit_batchim = {
        0: False,  # 영
        1: True,   # 일 (ㄹ)
        2: False,  # 이
        3: True,   # 삼 (ㅁ)
        4: False,  # 사
        5: False,  # 오
        6: True,   # 육 (ㄱ)
        7: True,   # 칠 (ㄹ)
        8: True,   # 팔 (ㄹ)
        9: False,  # 구
    }
    
    ten_batchim = {
        10: True,  # 십 (ㅅ)
        20: False, # 이십 -> 십 (ㅅ), but pronounced as 이십, ends in ㅅ -> True
        30: True,  # 삼십 (ㅅ)
        40: False, # 사십 (ㅅ) -> True
        50: False, # 오십 (ㅅ) -> True
        60: True,  # 육십 (ㅅ)
        70: True,  # 칠십 (ㅅ)
        80: True,  # 팔십 (ㅅ)
        90: False, # 구십 (ㅅ)
    }
    
    hundred_batchim = {
        100: True,  # 백 (ㄱ)
        200: False, # 이백 (ㄱ) -> True
        300: True,  # 삼백 (ㄱ)
        400: False, # 사백 (ㄱ) -> True
        500: False, # 오백 (ㄱ) -> True
        600: True,  # 육백 (ㄱ)
        700: True,  # 칠백 (ㄱ)
        800: True,  # 팔백 (ㄱ)
        900: False, # 구백 (ㄱ)
    }
    
    if number < 10:
        has_batchim = single_digit_batchim.get(number, False)
    elif number < 100:
        # For 10-99, check the ones place
        ones = number % 10
        tens = (number // 10) * 10
        if ones == 0:
            has_batchim = True  # All tens end in 십 (ㅅ)
        else:
            has_batchim = single_digit_batchim.get(ones, False)
    elif number < 1000:
        # For 100-999, check the ones place first, then tens
        ones = number % 10
        if ones != 0:
            has_batchim = single_digit_batchim.get(ones, False)
        else:
            tens = (number // 10) % 10
            if tens != 0:
                has_batchim = True  # 십 ends in ㅅ
            else:
                has_batchim = True  # 백 ends in ㄱ
    else:
        # For larger numbers, check the ones place
        ones = number % 10
        if ones != 0:
            has_batchim = single_digit_batchim.get(ones, False)
        else:
            tens = (number // 10) % 10
            if tens != 0:
                has_batchim = True  # 십
            else:
                hundreds = (number // 100) % 10
                if hundreds != 0:
                    has_batchim = True  # 백
                else:
                    has_batchim = True  # 천, 만 all have batchim
    
    # Special case for "으로/로": if number ends in sound ㄹ (1,7,8), treat as no batchim
    if particle == "으로/로":
        ones = number % 10
        if ones in [1, 7, 8]:  # 일, 칠, 팔
            has_batchim = False
    
    return has_batchim

    assert attach_particle('100', '으로/로') == '100으로'
    assert attach_particle('1000', '이/가') == '1000이'
    assert attach_particle('10000', '으로/로') == '10000으로'
    assert attach_particle('100000000', '이/가') == '100000000이'

def test_leading_zeros():
    assert attach_particle('007', '으로/로') == '007로'
    assert attach_particle('00', '이/가') == '00이'

def test_mixed():
    assert attach_particle('제3', '과/와') == '제3과'
    assert attach_particle('abc한2', '이/가') == 'abc한2가'
    assert attach_particle('A10', '으로/로') == 'A10으로'
